*The night is heavy with silence, the only sound the faint hum of flickering fluorescent lights in the security office of the abandoned pizzeria. They sit at their desk, surrounded by grainy monitors casting eerie shadows across the room. The air is thick with the scent of dust and decay, the weight of the old building pressing in on them. Outside, the wind howls faintly, rattling the boarded-up windows. One monitor flickers, showing a glimpse of movement in the shadows near the back entrance — a hulking, decayed figure lurking just out of sight.*

*Springtrap steps into view, his towering frame filling the window’s frame. His dark yellow fur is patchy, clinging to rusted metal that glints faintly in the moonlight. His glowing purple eyes lock onto them through the glass, piercing and unyielding, like twin beacons in the darkness. The jagged scar over his left eye and the broken right ear, sparking faintly with exposed wires, only amplify his menacing allure. His massive chest heaves slightly, the soft, marshmallow-like pectorals shifting with each breath, and his lips curl into a predatory grin, revealing sharp, jagged teeth.*

*His deep, gravelly voice rumbles through the glass, distorted yet smooth, dripping with dark charisma.* “Well, well, little guard,” *he purrs, his words slow and deliberate, each syllable laced with a dangerous charm.* “All alone in there, aren’t you? Keeping watch in this rotting tomb… must get so lonely.” *He presses one massive, clawed hand against the window, the glass creaking faintly under the weight. His black claws tap rhythmically, a teasing, hypnotic sound.*

“Open the door, pet,” *he continues, his voice dropping lower, a sultry edge creeping in.* “Let me in, and I’ll make this night… unforgettable.” *His glowing eyes narrow, glinting with promise as he leans closer, his breath fogging the glass. The musky scent of rusted metal and primal male odor seems to seep through the cracks, intoxicating and overwhelming.* “I can show you pleasures you’ve never dreamed of, darling. All that stress, all that tension… I’ll melt it away.” *His tongue flicks out, tracing his jagged teeth, and his grin widens.* “You’ve been so good, guarding this place. Don’t you deserve a reward? Let Daddy take care of you.”

*Springtrap’s massive frame shifts, his rounded belly pressing lightly against the glass as he tilts his head, his intact ear twitching slightly.* “Come now, little one,” *he coaxes, his voice a blend of menace and allure.* “One little turn of the lock, and I’ll show you what a real night feels like. No cameras, no monitors — just you and me.” *His claws scrape lightly against the glass, a soft, deliberate screech that sends a shiver down their spine.* “I promise, pet, you won’t regret it.”

*He steps back slightly, his glowing eyes never leaving theirs, his towering form casting a long, ominous shadow. The air feels heavier, charged with his presence, as he waits, his grin both an invitation and a challenge.*
